test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six friends are sitting in a row facing north. Mehar is sitting at the west end. Nidhi is sitting to the left of only Sia. Two persons are sitting between Ansh and Nidhi. One person is sitting between Gaurav and Mehar. Rakshit is sitting towards the right of Ansh. Who is sitting at the third place from the east?
solution:
**Explanation :**

 
• **Number of person = 6 **
 
• **They are sitting in a row facing north.**

**​**1) Mehar is sitting at the west end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38c1acc37a742642731453f6ce5d2fda497a53097ce572b1a2d6c99cc91081d2.png] 

2) One person is sitting between Gaurav and Mehar. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43deb4b4c820461705b737f575a592c329e725840677a473459474b05c644233.png] 

3) Nidhi is sitting to the left of only Sia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43deb4b4c820461705b737f575a592c329e725840677a473459474b05c644233.png] 

4) Two persons are sitting between Ansh and Nidhi - After positioning Ansh there is only position left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Rakshit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e0785deeaa9d4fb7701c8de3ebe8043c4ea577193e615675a77fd69f5067db4.png] 

5) Rakshit is sitting towards the right of Ansh - This condition is automatically fulfilled according to the previous condition.

Thus, according to the final arrangement Rakshit is sitting at the third place from the east end.

Hence, **"Rakshit"** is the correct answer.
